final: WITH g AS (SELECT a.translink AS k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg WHERE a.translink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), sh AS (SELECT g.k, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS share FROM g, tot WHERE tot.total > 0), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM sh), kept AS (SELECT sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - av.avgshare AS diff FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.avgshare) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_group_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_difference FROM kept
